Good work. That was the final exam, the last stage of Academy training. You have passed and are now ready to survive in this treacherous galaxy. You can move on to trading or bounty hunting, and align yourself with the Confederation, the Rebellion, or neither. The Academy is a neutral party, so we cannot help in this process. The Kestrel you have is yours to keep, as well as the credits. You may choose to start a new game, or continue with the current one.  Your ship, weapons, credits, and other items will remain with you.Hopefully this training and experience has prepared you for just about anything.
